description: The bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors across four different question-answering systems—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MusiQue, and IIRC—under three distinct configurations: NoR QA (orange bars), OneR QA (red bars), and IRGoT QA (blue bars). The vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled from 0 to 40 in increments of 5, while the horizontal axis lists the four datasets. For each dataset, the three bars are grouped together, with the legend indicating the corresponding configuration. The chart shows that the IRGoT QA configuration consistently results in the lowest number of factual errors across all datasets. For instance, in HotpotQA, the errors are 15 for NoR QA, 10 for OneR QA, and 5 for IRGoT QA. In 2WikiMQA, the values are 29, 23, and 14, respectively. In MusiQue, the numbers are 28, 27, and 23, and in IIRC, they are 15, 14, and 11. The NoR QA configuration yields the highest number of errors in all four datasets, while the OneR QA configuration generally produces fewer errors than NoR QA but more than IRGoT QA.
